EU Joins US Economic Campaign Against Iran Amid Strike Accusations

The European Union has officially joined a US-led economic campaign targeting Iran, described by US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent as 'Operation Economic Outcast.' This move signifies increased international pressure on Iran. Concurrently, Iran has accused the United States of civilian deaths following an alleged airstrike on a wedding in Kuhestak, near the Strait of Hormuz, which turned the gathering into a funeral. The US reportedly maintains military, economic, and covert options open regarding Iran, while international reports suggest that US pressure, including sanctions and blockades, is beginning to impact the country. A charity also reported that increased oil costs, linked to the conflict, are affecting aid delivery.
